name: Bangladesh
notes: Minimal but lopsided: one hooky rhythmic cell, hard drums, and space as the identity. The two parameters that make it are `kick.syncopation` 0.66 with `tresilloBias` 0.35 — the asymmetric 16th pattern the interviews describe — and `melody.densityPerBar` [1,3] against the genre's [3,8], because the research says the entire melodic content is a single chopped or looped cell with an extremely low pitch count. `hihat.continuous` is false: the research says the hats are sparse and syncopated rather than a continuous layer, and this is the one place a trap kit here is allowed to stop. `fillDensity` is 0.3 rather than lower so that every seed still gets hats. The drums swing slightly against the grid, so `swing.amount` is 0.54 rather than the genre's straight 0.5. ⚠ The research folds 2000–2013 into one continuous model deliberately, so this entry spans both poles rather than splitting. ⚠ The BPM range reconciles the research's two readings of the same records: 78–86 is the half-time *feel*, 156–172 the notated tempo, and 130–150 covers the non-signature cuts — `session.halfTime` inherited true is what makes those the same number. The research marks the earlier 2000–2007 pole's 76–92 straight-feel figure [LOW-CONF], so this range starts at 130 and does not chase it. ⚠ `chords.impliedByRiff` is set because the research says there is often no chord instrument at all and tonality is implied by the 808 root. The i–VII family carrying weight 1 is INFERRED — the research names only the static minor form, and it exists so the generated chord part reaches its distinct-output floor. ⚠ `anticipationProb` raised to 0.15. With `mirror_kick` against a fully locked 808 both parts take every kick, so every bass onset lands exactly on an 808 onset — `coherence.rs` calls that one line played twice rather than two parts locking. The lock is the style and is untouched; the anticipation is what makes them two parts. ⚠ **The countermelody reached only 827 distinct answers in 1000 seeds against a floor of 980**, so it was given range: styles 3, densityRatio 0.5, melody density [1,5]. A counter is combinatorial in the styles it may pick, its density against the melody, and the phrase length it answers inside — one style over a thin density inside a single phrase length has almost nothing a seed can vary. ⚠ **The 1-bar phrase length was removed** (was [1,2], now [2,4]). A one-bar phrase looped four times carries less entropy than a four-bar phrase, and it is the countermelody it strangles hardest: a counter answers *inside* the melody’s phrase, so a one-bar shape leaves it nowhere to go. Every worst offender on `counter.rs` carried it. ⛔ The previous session recorded this exact mistake and it arrived again from the other direction — distinctness is combinatorial in the shape LENGTH, not in the option count.
